summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature verification for: (1) 360-degree radial PoE2-style skill tree, (2) Attributes moved from Skill Tree into Character panel, (3) extended lighting (ground illum from hydropistol projectiles + directional shadows). Ran ~14 fresh Playwright sessions covering character-creation, camp navigation, seeded-save skill tree interaction, attribute purchase, node purchase, and live gameplay firing. VERDICT: PASS on all three core asks with zero console/page errors observed across every session (no GlProgram/Filter/uNormalTexture/resources errors).

ui_bugs.issue: These 3 sidebar tab buttons sit below the visible fold of the scrollable '.camp-tabs-scroll' list; Playwright's element.click() failed with 'outside of viewport' until manually scrolled into view. Likely a test-automation artifact (scrollIntoView not auto-triggered by ElementHandle.click in this harness) rather than a real user-facing bug, since the sidebar itself is scrollable and a real user can scroll to them manually. Recommend a quick manual check that these 3 tabs are reachable/clickable by scrolling the sidebar in a real browser.

action_items: No blocking issues found. Optional: verify tab-codex/tab-talent/tab-patrol are reachable via sidebar scroll in a real browser (likely fine, automation-only friction).

Optional polish: consider slightly increasing the minimum opacity of unlocked-but-locked-tier2+ nodes so players have a small visual cue that more of the wheel exists beyond the first ring (current 0.22 opacity is intentionally very faint per spec, but at first glance the wheel can look smaller than it is until zoomed in).
critical_code_review_comments: poe_tree.js radial math (BRANCH_ANGLES, POE_RADIAL_NODES) is a clean derived-projection over the existing linear dataset (no duplication of node costs/reqs) — good approach, single source of truth preserved.

SkillTree.jsx: isUnlocked() re-looks-up POE_RADIAL_INDEX inside a component-scope helper on every render for every node (65 nodes) — O(n) per render, fine at this scale but worth memoizing if the tree grows.
CharacterPanel.jsx availableAttrPoints() correctly computes earned (level-1) minus spent via Object.values(attrs).reduce — verified working via live buy test (5→4 points, atk 0→1).

pixiRenderer.js _drawPlayer/_drawEnemies shadow-offset logic (using this._testLight.mt term to scale shOffX/shOffY/shElong/shDark) is implemented as described; confirmed no crashes, ground illum (_drawGroundIllum using flatNormalTex + pooled sprites) is clearly visible as a large teal glow on/near hit enemies during live fire test.
No try/catch around _buildNormalLitSystem()/Filter.from() still (carried over recommendation from iteration_16-18) — low risk, not required now.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all 3 requested features verified working; only friction was test-automation viewport scrolling for 3 sidebar tabs (not a real app bug)

test_credentials: Not needed — localStorage-only guest flow (key 'wds.save.v1'), no login required for this scope.
seed_data_creation: Seeded via localStorage per instructions: sp:80, profile.level:6, skills:{poe_com0:1(or 1 for buy test), poe_com1:1, poe_mob0:1}, attrs:{}. IMPORTANT FINDING for future testing agents: after seeding localStorage you must ALSO set save.introSeen=true and save.tutorialDone=true before reloading, otherwise a reload replays the AIDA intro dialogue + auto-launches a forced Tutorial Run (pre-existing app behavior, unrelated to this session's changes) instead of returning to Camp. Without a reload, the seeded values are also invisible (React state was already loaded from localStorage before your setItem call), so buy/attribute flows will show stale (0 SP / 0 free points) until you reload with those two flags set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed via live Playwright sessions (screenshots + DOM/text assertions, not just code review): (1) Radial skill tree renders 9 branch categories evenly spaced 360° around a single center hub with concentric tier rings, START-node pulses on tier-0 nodes, locked nodes essentially invisible (very faint outline only) until unlocked, unlocked/purchased nodes reveal in branch color with glow — verified visually at multiple zoom levels. Pan (drag) and zoom (wheel) both work smoothly, no glitches. Clicking a node opens the right preview panel with name/desc/level-pips/cost, and buy-poe-<id> button correctly deducts SP (tested 80→79 SP) and increments level (1/3→2/3) with a toast confirmation. Skill Tree topbar confirmed to show ONLY 'SKILL TREE' title, SP count, hint text, and st-close button — no attribute badge/button present (verified via DOM query for old .poe-attr-badge/.poe-attr-overlay classes = none found). (2) Character panel's new char-attr-section renders all 7 POE_ATTRS (atk/dex/vit/mob/int/ele/mag) each with attr-<id> row and working attr-add-<id> '+' button; verified end-to-end: with profile.level=6 seeded, 5 free points showed correctly, clicking + on atk incremented its value to 1 and decremented free points to 4, and button correctly showed disabled=true when free points were 0 (unseeded fresh account). (3) Lighting: fired hydropistol repeatedly during a live tutorial-run gameplay session; player body renders as a round shaded sphere with distinct bright/dark sides (matches prior-session normal-map baseline); when a hydropistol bolt struck a nearby enemy, a large distinct teal/blue glow clearly illuminated the ground and the enemy area (confirms ground-illum requirement (b)) — screenshot evidence captured. Zero console errors, zero page errors, and specifically zero mentions of GlProgram/Filter.from/uNormalTexture/resources across all ~14 sessions (character creation, camp nav, skill tree interactions, node buys, attribute buys, and live gameplay firing). Directional shadow elongation on player/enemies (sub-items d/e) is implemented in code (confirmed via review of pixiRenderer.js _drawPlayer/_drawEnemies using this._testLight.mt) and no crashes were seen while it was actively rendering during fire, but the exact shadow-elongation delta between idle vs firing frames was subtle at the screenshot zoom level used and not pixel-measured — recommend a quick manual/human check of shadow lengthening specifically if 100% pixel-level certainty is needed, though this is LOW priority per the review request (cosmetic/positioning nuance, core mechanism confirmed present and non-crashing).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found requiring RCA this pass. One test-methodology note documented above (localStorage seeding requires introSeen+tutorialDone flags to avoid intro/tutorial detour) is not an app bug, just necessary context for future automated testing sessions.
